title: Space-Like End
description: Adds some Space Properties do the End dimension, such as zero gravity and zero air
body:
# Space-like End
**Have you ever wished the End dimension felt more like... space?**

This mod makes the end dimension a Low gravity, airless environment, without chaning the progression or feeling of the vanilla game

![Example image with a space helmet](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5343f38d6071c741ed17672d444c25074d799234.png)

## Features
### Space Helmet
- Crafted with **Tinted glass** and a **Netherite Ingot**
- Same properties as a Netherite Helmet
- Gives water breathing, just like the turtle shell
### New End Properties
- Low gravity behavior for players and mobs
- No fall damage
- No air, use a turtle shell, space helmet or water breathing potions to survive
